not_met.question: Q6
not_met.lacks: The developer of the generator, who writes the Making record, and the developer of the planner, who reads it through the Change and writes each small point into the tree as a decision by maker, can't tell how a small point joins the rest of the tree. In the data model at dev/rn/images/data-model.svg, a Decision answers exactly one Intent and a Deliverable holds it, but the Making record has no join to Intent or to Decision, as dev/rn/architecture.md:416-417, dev/rn/architecture.md:176-177, and dev/rn/architecture.md:596 leave it. So one developer may record a small point with no intent, and the other has to put the decision under an intent it picks itself, or under none. In the same way, the generator's own answer to each intent has no stated key, while the evaluator's Answers name each intent by its question's id, as dev/rn/architecture.md:418-420 says. Two developers can key the same answers in two ways.
